'''''Phattro''''' was an advertisement for the [[Phattro|alcoholic beverage]] of the same name, put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It featured the same motif as<ref name="Catch" /> the beverage it was named after<ref name="Lethal">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> and was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. One version of the ad was put up as a set of giant [[Painting/Legends|posters]] at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]]. However, these posters were mirror-inverted and faded. A complete and un-mirrored version was used as a billboard on a balcony in a different part of Coruscant's underworld.<ref name="Catch" /> A smaller, un-mirrored poster was put up on a wall near [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' dwelling, although a part of it had been torn off.<ref name="Wrong">{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}}</ref>
